legacyFallback.onGraphFailure: Discard graph output and preserve the legacy result while recording a local diagnostic.

shadowComparison.promotionRule: No non-exact category is silently converted into a successful match.

graphPathDisable.mechanism: Turn the proposed feature flag off without changing saved user data.

telemetryPolicy: No user telemetry may be added without a later explicit product and privacy decision.
rollbackAcceptanceCriteria: Legacy result remains available and unchanged.
Disabling the graph path requires no data migration.
Local comparison artifacts explain the disabling reason.
No GUI or browser control is introduced by this design document.
